en.name: Japanese curry roux
en.summary: Japanese curry roux is flour and spice cooked into hardened fat and sold as blocks in a foil-lined box. Sealed, it keeps about 12–24 months in the cupboard; once the foil is cut, about 1–3 months. The made-up pot of curry is the perishable part: 3–4 days in the fridge, or 2–3 months frozen.
en.pantry: Sealed boxes keep to the printed date in a cool dry cupboard, about 12–24 months from purchase — that range is what manufacturers print rather than an agency figure. What limits a curry block is the fat going rancid, not anything microbial, so keep it away from the cooker and out of the sun. Once the foil is cut, wrap the remaining blocks tightly or seal them in a bag and use them within about 1–3 months, the same rancidity clock given for opened salad oils. A white bloom on an old block is usually fat crystallising and is harmless; a crayon-like or paint-like smell means the fat has oxidised and the curry will taste of it.
en.fridge: This is where most people actually lose curry: the made-up pot, not the block. Japanese curry is a thick, low-acid, starchy stew that cools very slowly in the middle, so divide it into shallow containers, get it cold fast, and keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for 3–4 days. Reheat to a full rolling boil, stirring, rather than merely warming it through — a thick stew develops cold spots in a pan just as it does in a pot.
en.freezer: Made-up curry freezes well at −18 °C (0 °F) for about 2–3 months, minus the potatoes, which go grainy and mealy — fish them out before freezing or leave them out of the batch you intend to keep. Portion it flat in bags so it stacks and thaws quickly. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; the timeline is about flavour and texture. The blocks themselves do not need freezing.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen curry in the fridge overnight, or reheat it straight from frozen in a covered pan over low heat, stirring as it loosens. Bring it to a full boil before serving, and never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A crayon-like or paint-like smell from the blocks — the fat has oxidised
Insects or webbing inside the box
Made-up curry that smells sour, fizzes, or has a film on the surface
Mould anywhere on a block or on stored curry
tips: Reseal cut boxes in an airtight bag; air is what stales the fat.
Cool a big pot fast by splitting it into shallow containers.
Freeze curry without potatoes and add freshly cooked ones when you reheat.
Label frozen portions — curry looks much the same after a month in the freezer.

faq.q: How long does curry roux last once opened?
faq.a: About 1–3 months, sealed airtight in a cool cupboard. The limit is the fat going stale, not bacteria.

faq.q: How long does made-up Japanese curry keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–4 days at 4 °C or below, cooled quickly in shallow containers and reheated to a full boil.
Yes, about 2–3 months at −18 °C. Leave the potatoes out — they turn grainy after freezing.

faq.q: Is the white powder on an old curry block a problem?
faq.a: Usually not; it is fat crystallising on the surface. A crayon or paint smell is the real warning sign.

zh.name: 日式咖哩塊
zh.summary: 日式咖哩塊是把麵粉和香料炒進凝固的油脂裡做成的磚塊，裝在鋁箔內袋的紙盒裡。未開封放櫥櫃大約 12～24 個月；鋁箔剪開後大約 1～3 個月。真正容易壞的是煮好的那一鍋：冷藏 3～4 天，冷凍 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的盒子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 12～24 個月——這個範圍來自製造商的標示，不是主管機關的數字。限制咖哩塊的是油脂走油耗，不是微生物，所以請遠離爐火、避免日曬。鋁箔一剪開，剩下的塊要包緊或密封裝袋，並在大約 1～3 個月內用完，這和開封後沙拉油的油耗時鐘相同。放久的咖哩塊表面出現白霜，通常是油脂結晶，無害；但如果聞起來像蠟筆或油漆味，就是油脂已經氧化，煮出來的咖哩也會有那個味道。
zh.fridge: 多數人真正浪費掉的其實是這裡：煮好的那一鍋，而不是咖哩塊。日式咖哩是濃稠、低酸、含大量澱粉的燉煮物，中心降溫非常慢，所以請分裝成淺容器、快速冷卻，放 4 °C 以下，3～4 天內吃完。回鍋時要邊攪邊煮到大滾，不能只是加溫——濃稠的燉物在鍋裡也會有受熱不均的冷區。
zh.freezer: 煮好的咖哩在 −18 °C 冷凍大約 2～3 個月，效果很好，但馬鈴薯除外：它會變得粉粉沙沙的，冷凍前先挑出來，或打算要冷凍的那一批就別放。平放裝袋分裝，好堆疊也解凍得快。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，這裡的期限講的是風味和口感。咖哩塊本身則不需要冷凍。
zh.thawing: 冷凍咖哩請放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接蓋鍋小火從冷凍加熱，邊化邊攪。上桌前一定要煮到大滾，也絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 咖哩塊聞起來有蠟筆味或油漆味——油脂已經氧化
煮好的咖哩發酸、冒泡，或表面結了一層膜
咖哩塊或保存的咖哩上出現霉
tips: 開過的盒子請密封裝袋；讓油脂走味的是空氣。
一大鍋要分裝成淺容器快速降溫。
冷凍時不要放馬鈴薯，回鍋時再加現煮的。
冷凍分裝要貼標籤——咖哩冰過一個月看起來都差不多。

faq.q: 咖哩塊開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放陰涼櫥櫃大約 1～3 個月。限制是油脂走味，不是細菌。

faq.q: 煮好的日式咖哩放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 分裝淺容器快速降溫後放 4 °C 以下，3～4 天，回鍋要煮到大滾。
可以，−18 °C 大約 2～3 個月。馬鈴薯先挑掉，冷凍後會變沙。

faq.q: 咖哩塊上的白粉有問題嗎？
faq.a: 通常沒有，那是表面的油脂結晶。真正要警覺的是蠟筆味或油漆味。
